name: Release verification
description: Select or create a release and update canary, logs, and released Grafana screenshot proof.
instructions: For the Release verification template, releases are selected or created by version name only. Store proof in verifications.canary_screenshots, verifications.logs_screenshots, and verifications.grafana_screenshots files fields by passing browser File arrays or multipart FormData to $data. Use auth.currentUser() for the verifier identity; do not ask users to type an email.
